verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Meilisearch's seven built-in ranking rules and how to reorder them, along with typo tolerance, synonyms and analytics. None of it shows a way to return per-result ranking scores or score breakdowns explaining why a document ranked where it did. Configuring ranking rules is an adjacent feature, not inspection of ranking outcomes, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can inspect ranking scores or explanations to understand exactly why a result ranked where it did
